title: Establish source-pinned Haskell reference build inputs and constraints

acceptance_criteria.description: Source/image/build identities and remaining constraints are documented truthfully without altering Haskell.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Pinned source/archive/submodule records, exact Nix evaluation outcome and build/reference provenance result or explicit blockers.

evidence.command: Exact source/blob mode checks; proxy/cargohold Nix image evaluations; published image Config output identity comparisons; resource dry run and scoped migration check

handoff: Both published image configs match source-evaluated Nix output identities. Discovery is ready for independent review; no binary rebuild/unit/parity result is claimed. Task-owned reference builder is stopped with its cache retained.
